intro.text: A tall Thaylen captain of a military ship, whose crew includes Yalb.

items.text: Yalb was loyal to Smta for taking him on despite rumours about him. When he spotted the crewless First Dreams, Smta had him lead a boarding party, and he knew she would want to bring the ship home to help the war effort.

appearance.text: Tall, with curled eyebrows matching her hair.
